title: l1qw.23.3: Rust+C: implement handoff state-transfer for link replay window
description: Port the handoff state-transfer from Python (l1qw.23.2) to Rust lichen-gateway and C gcp_trust. C link_ctx.h:102-103 has epoch/tx_seq persisted via NVS but only for single-node boot, not gateway-to-gateway transfer. Wire the handoff encode/decode path so the new gateway's replay window starts from the transferred state.
